criteria.notes: Criterion 4 cannot fail as written; owner has not chosen 4b.
Do not replace criterion 4 without the owner choice.
Use army intervals and simultaneous test. Light and Dark may exceed other kings if equal to each other.
No numeric equivalence margin is found. An interval that contains zero does not prove equality.
No direct owner quote adopting the numeric band is found. Do not claim one. Card usefulness, usage and interactions also matter.
Queue requires depth-4 confirmation with no draw drag. Numeric noninferiority margin is not specified; a non-significant rise is not proof of no drag.
Piece criterion 6 has its separate ±2-point presence limit. Do not silently apply that as an absolute White band.
Outside the linear band report a bound. Keep reference engine price, seed prices and calibration error.
